The '''SH-9 slugthrower pistol''',<ref name="ROE" /> also known as the '''whisper pistol''', was a magazine fed [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]] with an inbuilt [[Silencer (component)|silencer]]<ref name="FIB" /> manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]].<ref name="ROE" /> The weapon was favored to covert ops for silent takedowns due to its ability to pierce laminate [[Armor/Legends|armors]].<ref name="FIB" />

Made from composite materials, the SH-9 was easy to hide and difficult to detect by a [[Weapon detector|weapons scan]] even by an experienced sensor technician. The weapon was capable of function even when wet or submerged.<ref name="FIB" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] modified the weapon to make it even quieter. The only noise it made was the faint clicking of the slide as it moved. These modified SH-9s were used by [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]],<ref name="ROE" /> and [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] [[operative]]s.<ref name="FIB" />
